annotations.title: Get a skill's SKILL.md + install metadata

description: Fetch everything an agent needs to adopt a Registry skill: the full SKILL.md (agentskills.io standard — frontmatter name/description + body), its classification (prompt-shaped vs scripted vs mcp), and required binaries. To install: save the returned skill_md as SKILL.md inside a folder named after the slug in your agent's skills directory.

provider.description: Registry provider from registry_search (e.g. 'rokha', 'clawhub', 'smithery'). Omit to auto-resolve: first-party 'rokha' listings are tried first, then 'clawhub'.

name: registry_get_skill
